overview: 今日专题“军事、安全与突发事件”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: British government ‘complacent about food as a national security matter’
items.summary: Experts say country does not have plan to feed people in a crisis and is unprepared for future shortages Britain does not have a plan for how to feed people in a crisis and is unprepared for potential future food shortages, according to a warning from more than 150 experts delivered to Andy Burnham. The climate crisis, geopolitical shocks, cyber-attacks and energy outages are among the threats to food chain security, according to the open letter, which claims the government is “complacent about food as a national security matter”. Establish a new system of local food resilience committees under the Civil Contingencies Act 2004. Audit the UK’s reliance on a few very large food companies and food imports. Realign national food production around nutritional needs. Create national, regional, local and community food storage schemes. Support the decentralisation of the UK’s food supply. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 英国政府被指“对粮食作为国家安全问题掉以轻心”
items.summaryZh: 超过150名专家致信安迪·伯纳姆，警告英国缺乏应对危机时的粮食供应计划，且对未来的粮食短缺准备不足。专家们呼吁建立地方粮食韧性委员会，并重新评估国家对进口和大型食品企业的依赖。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了气候变化与地缘政治风险下，英国在保障国家粮食安全方面面临的严峻挑战与政策缺失。

items.title: Who were the top teen athletes at the Asian Games?

items.summaryZh: 在亚运会中，19岁的中国选手张展硕斩获七枚金牌，表现亮眼。同时，其队友余子迪也赢得了三枚打破纪录的金牌。
items.whyImportant: 这些年轻选手的卓越表现展示了亚洲体育界后备人才的强劲实力。

items.titleZh: 数据显示中东石油出口量尽管局势紧张仍超过战前水平
items.summaryZh: 尽管地区局势持续紧张，但最新数据表明中东地区的石油出口量已超过战前水平。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队指挥官表示，通过霍尔木兹海峡受美国监管航线的石油流量“微不足道”。
items.whyImportant: 该数据反映了全球能源市场在复杂地缘政治背景下的韧性，以及主要产油国在冲突压力下维持出口的能力。

items.title: If BTS has to serve, why are South Korean sportsmen, artists exempt: ex-lawmaker
items.summary: A former South Korean lawmaker has called for the abolition of the military exemption system granted to outstanding national athletes, arguing that military service should not be used as an incentive for achievements in sports or the arts. Yoo Seong-min’s remarks came amid controversy over comments made by members of South Korea’s men’s football team, who recently won its fourth consecutive Asian Games title, regarding the military benefits they received. South Korea defeated host Japan 1-0 on...

items.titleZh: 前议员质疑：若防弹少年团必须服兵役，为何韩国运动员和艺术家可以豁免？
items.summaryZh: 韩国前议员柳承敏呼吁废除针对优秀运动员和艺术家的兵役豁免制度，认为不应将兵役作为奖励成就的手段。此番言论是在韩国男足夺得亚运会冠军后，围绕队员兵役福利引发争议的背景下提出的。
items.whyImportant: 这一讨论触及了韩国社会关于兵役公平性及国家荣誉激励机制的长期争议。

items.title: Hong Kong outlines 4-step AI ‘talent ladder’ to offset entry-level job shock
items.summary: Hong Kong has unveiled a four-step artificial intelligence (AI) “talent ladder” strategy to counter entry-level job shock and foster industry leaders, viewing the technology as a “catalyst, not a threat”. Permanent Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Kevin Choi Kit-ming warned on Monday that the “entry-level shock” was real because AI performed well in many routine tasks that once made up a graduate’s first job, such as basic coding and first-line customer service. Speaking at the...

items.titleZh: 香港推出四步走人工智能“人才阶梯”，以应对入门级职位冲击
items.summaryZh: 香港政府提出人工智能“人才阶梯”战略，旨在应对AI对初级职位（如基础编程和客服）的冲击。当局将人工智能视为行业发展的催化剂，而非威胁。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了香港在数字化转型过程中，通过政策引导来缓解劳动力市场结构性调整的压力。

items.title: Iran tells US there is no military solution to war as talks hit impasse
items.summary: Iran’s top diplomat insisted on Sunday that there would be no military solution to the United States’ war against the Islamic republic, with talks on ending the conflict apparently at an impasse. A campaign of heavy bombardment failed to bring a decisive close to the war launched by the US and Israel in late February, and Washington in recent weeks has dialled back military operations in favour of economic pressure. The main point of contention remains Iran’s attempt to blockade the Strait of...

items.titleZh: 伊朗告知美国：战争没有军事解决方案，谈判陷入僵局
items.summaryZh: 伊朗外交官表示，美国与伊朗之间的冲突无法通过军事手段解决，目前相关谈判已陷入僵局。尽管美国此前采取了军事轰炸和经济压力等手段，但未能达成预期目标。
items.whyImportant: 谈判僵局显示美伊冲突的复杂性，且短期内通过外交途径解决的可能性依然较低。

items.title: US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford
items.summary: A statement says all bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been "re-deployed to their home stations" in the US.

items.titleZh: 美国空军撤离英国费尔福德空军基地的所有轰炸机
items.summaryZh: 美国空军发表声明称，所有部署在英国费尔福德空军基地的轰炸机已撤回美国本土基地。此次行动标志着该基地轰炸机部署任务的结束。
items.whyImportant: 此举是美军全球军事部署调整的一部分，可能影响北约在欧洲地区的战略威慑态势。

items.title: India seeks to be ‘a little bit more involved’ in ending Ukraine war: minister
items.summary: India is taking a more direct role in efforts to end the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, engaging both sides on issues including shipping and reducing hostilities, Minister of External Affairs S. Jaishankar has said. Speaking at a security conference over the weekend, Jaishankar said India in recent months has become “a little bit more involved beyond advocacy”. The comments point to a more active role for New Delhi after years of taking a cautious approach to the war, in part because of...

items.titleZh: 印度外长称寻求在结束乌克兰战争中发挥“更多参与”作用
items.summaryZh: 印度外交部长苏杰生表示，印度正采取更直接的行动以推动俄乌冲突结束，并与双方就航运及减少敌对行动等议题进行接触。这标志着印度从以往谨慎的立场转向更积极的调停角色。
items.whyImportant: 印度外交政策的这一转变显示其试图在全球冲突中提升影响力，并发挥更具建设性的外交作用。

items.title: Serb separatist Dodik declares victory for his party in Bosnia election
items.summary: Bosnian Serb nationalist politician Milorad Dodik has declared victory for his party in an election in Bosnia and Herzegovina on Sunday that was shaped by economic pressures, the prospect of the Balkan nation joining the European Union and ethnic tensions that have divided the country since its brutal 1992–95 war. Dodik is a staunchly pro-Russia politician who, despite not appearing on the ballot, has dominated the campaign and inflamed divisions with separatist rhetoric that have sparked fears...

items.titleZh: 塞尔维亚族分裂主义者多迪克宣布在波黑选举中获胜
items.summaryZh: 波黑塞族民族主义政治家米洛拉德·多迪克宣布其政党在选举中获胜。此次选举受到经济压力、加入欧盟前景及国内民族矛盾的影响，多迪克的分裂主义言论引发了外界对国家稳定的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 多迪克的胜选可能加剧波黑国内的民族分裂，并对该国与欧盟的整合进程及地区安全造成负面影响。

items.title: Authorities issue shark warning over whale that swam 11km upstream in Clarence River and later died
items.summary: The juvenile humpback was spotted near Bundjalung National Park in what experts say is a rare, but not unprecedented event While the case of a whale found 11km upstream in a New South Wales river this weekend was unusual, it was not unprecedented, experts say. The juvenile humpback, which swam into the Clarence River on the state’s mid-north coast and later died, was towed out to sea on Sunday, according to NSW authorities. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 鲸鱼游入克拉伦斯河上游11公里处死亡，当局发布鲨鱼预警

items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对海洋生物异常行为及河流生态安全的关注，并促使当局采取了必要的安全防范措施。

items.title: BBC morale dented by gradual ‘bloodletting’ after weeks of job cuts
items.summary: Plans to shed as many as 2,000 employees have been announced in stages, and staff fear further cuts in 2027 Morale at the BBC has been severely dented by a gradual “bloodletting” that has seen plans to shed as many as 2,000 staff slowly announced over several weeks, members of the corporation’s staff have warned. More internal meetings have been called for this week to discuss further details of the cuts, which aim to save £500m. Some staff already fear that further waves of cuts will follow soon after in the new year. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: BBC在数周裁员后士气受挫，面临持续的“放血”式削减
items.summaryZh: BBC计划裁减多达2000名员工，分阶段的裁员公告严重打击了员工士气。内部员工担心，为了实现5亿英镑的成本削减目标，明年可能会出现新一轮的裁员。
items.whyImportant: 大规模裁员不仅影响BBC的运营效率，也引发了外界对其作为公共广播机构未来内容生产能力和公信力的担忧。

items.titleZh: 尽管联合国发出警告，仍有近1500名移民从马来西亚抵达缅甸
items.summaryZh: 尽管联合国警告缅甸处于活跃战区且环境不安全，马来西亚仍持续进行大规模难民遣返。此次遣返行动引发了国际社会对难民人身安全的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了马来西亚在处理难民问题时与国际人权标准之间的持续冲突。

items.title: Yemen’s Saudi-backed government launches military drive to retake all Houthi-held territory
items.summary: The announcement came hours after Iranian-backed Houthis reportedly cut a vital supply route to besieged city of Taiz Yemen’s Saudi-backed government has announced the start of a new military operation to retake all territory held by the Houthis, even as the militant group made fresh gains on the ground, reportedly encircling a government-held city. Rashad al-Alimi, the head of Yemen’s presidential council, said in a statement on Sunday: “I announce today the start of military operations to retake the remaining territories of the republic and extend the authority of the state and its institutions across the entire national territory.” Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 也门沙特支持的政府发起军事行动，旨在收复所有胡塞武装控制区
items.summaryZh: 在胡塞武装切断塔伊兹市重要补给线后，也门总统委员会宣布发起全面军事行动，旨在收复被胡塞武装占领的领土。政府希望通过此举恢复国家机构对全国领土的管辖权。
items.whyImportant: 该行动标志着也门内战局势的进一步升级，可能对该地区的稳定产生深远影响。

items.summary: Beijing has been urged to do more to protect its overseas interests with a call for diplomatic engagement to reshape international rules and deeper security cooperation with other countries. As China’s expanding global footprint comes under pressure from geopolitics and restrictions from the West, a Chinese analysis posted on the Global Security Research social media account has called for a major shift in strategy. The author was not identified, but the account regularly posts analysis and...

items.titleZh: 中国被敦促建立“体系”以保护不断扩大的海外利益
items.summaryZh: 有分析指出，面对地缘政治压力和西方限制，中国应通过外交手段重塑国际规则，并加强与其他国家的安全合作。建立完善的海外利益保护体系已成为当前战略讨论的重点。
items.whyImportant: 这表明中国正在重新评估其全球战略，以应对日益复杂的国际安全环境。

items.title: HKU eyes Northern Metropolis expansion to boost research capacity, attract talent
items.summary: The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is looking to secure more laboratory space in the Northern Metropolis university town to expand its research capacity and attract talent, its new vice-president for research has said. Professor Anderson Shum Ho-cheung, who took up the vice presidency in August, also called for more government funding, saying grant applications took time and returns on investment could be slow. Shum said the university’s research development would align with the government’s...
items.titleZh: 香港大学着眼于北部都会区扩张，以提升研究能力并吸引人才
items.summaryZh: 香港大学计划在北部都会区获取更多实验室空间，以扩大研究规模并吸引全球人才。校方同时呼吁政府增加科研拨款，以加快研究成果的转化。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在配合香港政府的区域发展规划，进一步巩固香港作为国际科研枢纽的地位。

items.title: 1,500 Hong Kong residents tour revamped Huanggang Port border crossing
items.summary: More than 1,500 Hong Kong residents toured the revamped Huanggang Port border crossing on Sunday as authorities pushed ahead with preparations for its opening. A Security Bureau spokesman said that participants took franchised buses or cross-boundary coaches from various districts to reach the crossing and were shown the new port building in groups. “The event effectively enhanced participants’ understanding of the public transport arrangements, immigration and customs clearance and...

items.titleZh: 1500名香港居民参观翻新后的皇岗口岸边境检查站
items.summaryZh: 超过1500名香港居民于周日参观了翻新后的皇岗口岸，以熟悉口岸的交通安排及通关流程。此次活动是为口岸正式启用所做的准备工作之一。
items.whyImportant: 皇岗口岸的升级将进一步提升粤港两地的跨境交通效率与通关便利性。

items.title: White House defends new press aide who posed with rifle in ‘Fuck Joe Biden’ shirt
items.summary: Beni Rae Harmony, 24, has been ‘a trusted voice for the MAGA movement as a White House correspondent’, White House says The White House has defended a newly hired press aide who posed for a holiday photograph in 2021 wearing a “Fuck Joe Biden” T-shirt and holding a rifle. Beni Rae Harmony, the new assistant White House press secretary, revealed on Friday that she was going to work for Donald Trump just days after covering him as a correspondent for Real America’s Voice, a partisan rightwing outlet originally created as a video podcast platform for the president’s former adviser Steve Bannon. items.titleZh: 白宫为新任新闻助理辩护，该助理曾身穿印有“去你的乔·拜登”字样的T恤并手持步枪拍照
items.summaryZh: 白宫为新聘用的助理新闻秘书贝尼·雷·哈莫尼辩护，她曾因一张身穿侮辱性T恤并手持步枪的旧照引发争议。哈莫尼此前曾作为右翼媒体的记者报道特朗普，现已加入白宫新闻团队。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了关于白宫人事任命标准及政治极化影响的讨论。

items.title: JD Vance flexing Maha connections as he eyes 2028 election
items.summary: Considered Republican frontrunner for presidential election, Vance is cozying up to the movement – as it splits JD Vance, widely considered to be the Republican frontrunner for the presidential election in 2028, is aligning himself with the Make America Healthy Again (Maha) movement as some say it is shedding its grassroots supporters in favor of political and corporate interests. The US vice-president has positioned himself as the inheritor of Make America Great Again (Maga), and attaching himself to Maha, which many in the Trump administration believe helped to win the 2024 election, signals a greater overlap between the two movements as the administration’s popularity plummets amid the war in Iran and rising prices. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 万斯着眼2028年大选，积极拉拢“让美国再次健康”运动
items.summaryZh: 被视为共和党2028年总统候选人热门人选的万斯，正寻求与“让美国再次健康”（Maha）运动结盟。尽管该运动内部存在分歧，但万斯此举旨在巩固其作为“让美国再次伟大”（Maga）继承人的地位，以应对当前政府支持率下滑的挑战。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了共和党内部政治力量的重组及对未来选举策略的调整。

items.title: How the ‘G2’ effect of Trump-Xi summit is reverberating through Asia
items.summary: For American and Chinese people interested in the outcome of the latest summit between China’s President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump, their conclusions could not be more different if they turn to the media and pundits for guidance. Chinese state media spared no superlative, echoing the official description of the summit as: forging the right way for the major powers to get along and writing a new chapter in ties. It played up the fact that Trump gave Xi the highest-level reception...
items.titleZh: “特习会”的“G2”效应如何在亚洲产生回响
items.summaryZh: 中美两国媒体对特朗普与习近平最新峰会成果的解读截然不同。中国官方媒体强调峰会为大国相处指明了方向，并给予了高规格接待，而美国舆论则呈现出更为复杂的视角。
items.whyImportant: 峰会解读的差异凸显了中美两国在处理双边关系及国际舆论引导上的不同侧重点。

items.title: Trump names intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new White House AI czar
items.summary: Clayton had said AI was a ‘gamechanger’ but also posed ‘a threat’ during his confirmation hearing Donald Trump on Sunday named Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, to also serve as the new White House AI czar. Clayton, who leads the US’s 18 intelligence agencies, previously served as the top federal prosecutor in Manhattan and led the Securities and Exchange Commission during Trump’s first term. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普任命情报主管杰伊·克莱顿为白宫人工智能负责人
items.summaryZh: 特朗普任命现任国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿兼任白宫人工智能负责人。克莱顿此前曾担任证券交易委员会主席，他在确认听证会上曾表示人工智能既是变革性力量，也构成潜在威胁。
items.whyImportant: 此任命将国家安全与人工智能监管职能整合，显示了政府对AI技术战略影响力的重视。

items.title: Four African leaders issue joint declaration as Ethiopia war escalates
items.summary: Egyptian, Eritrean, Somali and Sudanese leaders also call for talks to end the civil war in Sudan.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 随着埃塞俄比亚战争升级，四位非洲领导人发表联合声明
items.summaryZh: 埃及、厄立特里亚、索马里和苏丹的领导人发表联合声明，呼吁通过对话结束苏丹内战。此举是在埃塞俄比亚冲突加剧的背景下做出的外交努力。
items.whyImportant: 该声明旨在通过区域协作缓解非洲之角日益严峻的安全局势。

items.title: Russia strikes Kyiv bridge as Germany’s Merz visits, pledges aid

Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko then confirmed that a strike had damaged the road surface on the Northern Bridge – one of several connecting...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 德国总理默茨访问基辅期间，俄罗斯袭击基辅桥梁
items.summaryZh: 德国总理默茨对基辅进行突访以示支持，期间俄罗斯发动无人机袭击，导致基辅北部大桥路面受损。此次袭击发生在空袭警报声中，凸显了乌克兰首都当前面临的安全威胁。

items.title: Malaysia’s Anwar set to unveil crowd-pleasing budget as political pressure rises
items.summary: Malaysia’s Anwar Ibrahim is expected to roll out a populist budget on Friday aimed at placating voter concerns over the cost of living and access to essential services, experts say, as the prime minister seeks to shore up support ahead of a general election that could be called as soon as next year. Anwar’s coalition government is under mounting pressure amid a deepening feud with Umno. items.titleZh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔面临政治压力，准备公布受民众欢迎的预算案
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔预计将推出一项民粹主义预算案，旨在缓解民众对生活成本上涨的担忧。在执政联盟内部矛盾加剧及大选临近的背景下，此举旨在巩固其政治支持基础。
items.whyImportant: 该预算案的成败将直接影响安瓦尔政府的执政稳定性及未来的选举前景。
